canon_hash: PENDING — assigned at Phase 0 data lock (system-spec §9, §13 item 0.4)

key_lines: Hi! I'm Dotty! That was leaked footage from 2032. The people in it all remember it differently. Let's ruin some reputations together.
They did not tow the fuel tank. They towed the fuel.
You decide. I'm just a bot with a badge.
It's just math. TNT, and how you release it, and what happens.
They thought they were stealing a mineral. They were stealing a question.
characters.millennium_framing: Dotty frames the core's mysteries as Millennium-Prize-style prize problems — open problems that everyone, and every AI, is trying to answer
characters.name: Dotty
characters.objective: curate the archive; hand contradictions to the reader
characters.pov_grammar: bureaucratic overlays; worsening redactions; sticky-note marginalia in handwritten marker
characters.role: AI archivist docent (Docent Over-Transparent Tour-bot Yapper)
running_gags: redactions worsen until: "I don't remember writing that."
characters.seed_note: in 2051 the archive holds robot telemetry — some of it recent. Dotty does not say whether anything is still awake down there

characters.hidden_objective: ensure nobody can ever use the core
key_lines: You keep asking who owns the moon. That is the wrong question.
characters.life_question: "Was there life — or anything — that they destroyed?" — did Mimas, or the core's parent planet, hold life, or a record, or something irreplaceable that the stripping destroyed? UNANSWERED. The moral Millennium question, and it is Ren's.
characters.name: Ren
characters.objective: save the moon (+ secretly sabotage the mission: inefficient trajectories, falsified fracture estimates, diverted coolant, buying the moon hours, disabling core-chamber equipment — then leaks the Slip data to make extraction impossible)
characters.pov_grammar: immaculate log; vault-door official story; zero past-tense verbs
characters.role: Captain — sympathetic, protecting her crew; the cover-up is false and the story knows it

key_lines: You need everything to accomplish everything about the unknown.
We spent twelve years figuring out how to move it. Nobody asked whether we should.
It doesn't need to arrive slow. Fast arrival just means a bigger capture orbit. It only ever needed to fall.
characters.name: Qiao
characters.pov_grammar: annotated flight recorder; marginalia: "Don't move this one."; 72-hour gap labeled only 'Saturn extraction operations'
characters.role: Co-pilot / taikonaut — the tragedy inside the comedy
characters.twelve_years_conflict: UNRESOLVED — Phase 0 open item: Qiao's locked line "We spent twelve years figuring out how to move it" conflicts with the ~4–5-year active voyage arc and the 2049–2052 billiards chain (drama-spec §6; system-spec §0)

characters.hidden_objective: controls the story itself (runs her own operation; testimony as leveraged buyout of the truth)
